name: pr-review-agent
description: Multi-agent GitHub pull request reviewer — MCP server, web dashboard, and VS Code extension. Runs against any host repository.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix mcp-server install && npm --prefix vscode-extension install && npm run install:web
scripts.install:web: cd web && npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web && npm run build:extension
scripts.test: npm --prefix mcp-server test && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix mcp-server run typecheck && npm run typecheck:web && npm --prefix vscode-extension run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
